files.p.yaml:
cpl: "1.0"
id: vector-policy
version: 1
default: deny
strategy: deny_overrides
rules:
  - id: allow-big
    match: {kind: [tool_call]}
    when: {expr: "arguments.n > 3"}
    outcome: allow
  - id: deny-sig
    match: {kind: [tool_call]}
    when: {signal: {code: scan.destructive}}
    outcome: deny
    reason: RULE_DENY
